fact: NIMC's director-general says over 206,000 refugees and internally displaced persons have been enrolled into the national identity database.
NIMC's director-general says refugees and internally displaced persons have been enrolled into the national identity database so that no one is left behind.
NIMC's director-general puts refugees and internally displaced persons enrolled in the national identity database at over 206,000.
UNHCR states refugees in Nigeria can enrol in the national identity management system to obtain identity documents.
President Tinubu said special exercises were conducted to enrol refugees and internally displaced persons in the national identity database.

The Federal Government, UNHCR and Germany handed 10 mobile one-stop-shop vehicles to 10 states to take NIN, birth registration, SIM registration and bank account opening to displaced people, against an estimated 3.7 million internally displaced.
UNHCR, relayed by EUAA, says that in 2024 51.78% of IDPs and 46.01% of refugees and asylum seekers held legally recognised identity documents or credentials.
UNHCR, relayed by EUAA, says about 1,950 refugees in the South-South region were enrolled in state social registers, giving access to the Nigerian Identification Number and bank accounts.
UNHCR, relayed by EUAA, gives the share with a bank account in 2024 as 0.42% of IDPs and 29.22% of refugees and asylum seekers.
